name: Residence Visa for Studying in the UAE

requirements.blocker_text: Must be enrolled at an accredited UAE university or institute, which sponsors the visa; requires a certificate specifying the duration of study.
requirements.fix_path: Secure enrolment at an accredited UAE institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Alternatively, may be sponsored by a parent who is a UAE resident -- male children up to age 25, female children of any age until marriage.

evidence_required.document: University/institute enrolment certificate specifying study duration

sources.title: The Official Portal of the UAE Government (u.ae) -- Residence Visa for Studying in the UAE: sponsorship either by an accredited university/college or by a UAE-resident parent (sons up to 25, daughters of any age until marriage), university-facilitated visa process

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the UAE's full build-out. No fee figures were found on this source. switchable_to reflects the page's own mention that outstanding student performers may qualify for the Golden Visa (see ae_golden_visa.json's talent category), and that graduates commonly transition to employment-based status (see ae_work_permit.json), though neither is a guaranteed or automatic conversion.
